# dsh-feishucard

> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ↔ Feishu / Lark bridge plugin with a streaming reply card.
> Self-developed (not a fork). MIT licensed. Node >= 22.15.

## What it is

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) host plugin that bridges Feishu / Lark chats to DSH agent sessions over the
**official SDK WebSocket long connection** — no public IP, domain, or tunnel required.
Packaged as one npm package: host plugin + long-connection helper subprocess + an auto-registered
bundle patch.

## Capabilities

- **Streaming reply card** — inline agent notes, collapsible tool-call panels with status symbols
- **Many bots in ONE instance** — each bot bound to its own workspace and `AGENTS.md`
- **Mention-gated group replies** — in group chats the bot answers only when mentioned; private chats always answer
- **Approval cards & ask-user questions** — tool approvals and agent questions arrive as Feishu cards; tap to answer
- **`/switch` two-level picker** — workspace → session (same source as the GUI sidebar), plus `/list` `/new` `/help`
- **Identity injection** — inbound messages resolve to a person; tool-call identity fields are overwritten from the identity table
- **Reliability fallbacks** — rate-limit handling, backoff, circuit breaker, plain-text fallback

## Install

```
npm i dsh-feishucard
```

Then register the plugin with DSH (see `README.md` for the exact `dsh plugin add` / profile patch steps).

## Configuration

- Config file: `~/.dsh-feishucard/feishu.config.json`
- Shape: `{ "bots": [ { "name": "...", "workspace": "/abs/path", "appId": "cli_...", "appSecret": "..." } ] }`
- Requires a Feishu (Lark) custom app with the **bot** capability and **long connection** enabled
